      • Distance pacing cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety.       • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

This 2018 Chevrolet Equinox LS offers a reliable combination of practicality and comfort for today's driver, delivering capable performance in a well-designed package that handles both city commutes and highway drives with confidence.

- Backup Camera
- Bluetooth
- Alloy Wheels
- Keyless Entry
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Chevrolet MyLink AM/FM Stereo
- Cruise Control
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Brake Assist
- Electronic Stability Control
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes
- Power Windows
- All-Weather Floor Mats
- Telescoping Steering Wheel
- Split Folding Rear Seat

The Equinox LS combines fuel efficiency with everyday utility. Its 1.5L DOHC engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission delivers 26 city and 32 highway miles per gallon, making it an economical choice for regular driving. The front-wheel-drive configuration ensures stable handling, while the spacious cabin provides comfortable seating for five passengers with practical storage solutions.

Technology features keep you connected and in control. The Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system integrates with both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing seamless smartphone integration. Bluetooth connectivity enables hands-free calling and audio streaming, while SiriusXM satellite radio access expands your entertainment options. The backup camera provides added confidence when reversing into tight spaces.

Safety is prioritized in this model with multiple layers of protection. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and an occupant sensing system work together with four-wheel disc brakes and electronic stability control. Brake assist technology helps you stop more effectively in emergency situations, and traction control maintains grip on varied road conditions.

The interior balances comfort with practicality. Premium cloth seating, manual seat adjustments, and a rear seat center armrest accommodate multiple passengers. Features like the telescoping steering wheel, tilt steering, and power windows enhance daily convenience. The split-folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility for larger items, while all-weather floor mats protect the cabin from seasonal elements.

The white exterior with alloy wheels gives the Equinox LS a clean, contemporary appearance that's easy to maintain and suitable for any setting. With over 118,000 miles, this vehicle demonstrates the durability Chevrolet is known for, and it's priced to reflect its mileage while still offering years of capable service ahead.

The leather-appointed interior feels substantial and refined, and memory seat functionality recalls your preferred driving position each time you enter the vehicle. The power panoramic moonroof floods the cabin with natural light and openness.

Daily convenience matters, and this vehicle addresses it thoroughly. Keyless entry eliminates fumbling for keys, while the power seats adjust to your preferred position at the touch of a button. Heated door mirrors improve visibility in winter weather, and fog lights enhance forward visibility in challenging conditions. The rear window wiper clears precipitation from your rear glass, and speed-sensitive wipers adjust their pace based on driving conditions.

This Murano SL represents a practical choice for buyers seeking a well-equipped crossover with a proven V6 engine, AWD capability, and comprehensive comfort and safety features.

- Fresh service completed with new rear brakes

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design and practical refinement. The heated front seats provide comfort during cold months, while the dual-zone climate control ensures both driver and passenger satisfaction. The split folding rear seat adapts quickly to accommodate passengers or cargo, and the power moonroof opens up the interior space. Navigation comes standard to help you reach your destination with confidence.

Safety features underscore Volkswagen's commitment to driver protection. You'll find six airbags, including front side and overhead protection, along with electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes on all four wheels, and a low tire pressure warning system. The rearview camera assists with parking and backing procedures.

This Tiguan has been well-maintained with fresh service and new rear brakes recently installed, making it ready for the road. Two VW keys provide convenient flexibility for household drivers. This model represents an efficient use of your automotive investment and stands ready to serve your transportation needs with reliability and practicality.

Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension maintain secure handling in various driving situations.

The well-appointed exterior includes fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality, fog lights for enhanced visibility, and heated power door mirrors for year-round convenience. The roof rack with rails provides practical cargo carrying capability, while the power liftgate offers easy access to the cargo area. Turn signal indicator mirrors and rain-sensing wipers add to the user-friendly design that defines this model.

Whether you prioritize reliable daily transportation, luxury appointments, or versatile cargo capacity, this 2018 Mercedes-Benz GLC 300 checks the boxes for discerning drivers who value both function and quality. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and knee airbags provide additional protection. The backup camera offers visibility when reversing, while electronic stability control and traction control support secure handling in challenging situations.

The Altitude Special Edition trim distinguishes this Compass with exclusive styling touches. The black roof, black grille with black rings, gloss black badges, and black daylight opening moldings create a cohesive appearance. Gloss black fog lamp bezels and the gloss black lower rear fascia valance add refinement, while the bright exhaust tip provides a finishing detail. These design elements work together to express a refined personality without compromising the vehicle's practical nature.

- Chrome Rear Bumper Protector

The Rogue S combines responsive handling with everyday convenience. Its 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission delivers solid efficiency, returning 26 mpg in city driving and 33 mpg on the highway. You'll appreciate the smooth power delivery whether navigating city streets or cruising on longer drives, and the front-wheel-drive setup provides good traction in various weather conditions.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed cabin that prioritizes comfort and usability. The front bucket seats provide adequate support for extended driving, while the split folding rear seat gives you flexibility to accommodate both passengers and cargo as your needs change. The telescoping steering wheel and tilt adjustment allow you to find your ideal driving position easily. Climate control with rear window defroster ensures comfort for all occupants throughout the year.

Safety and security have been prioritized with this Rogue. Multiple airbags including dual front impact and dual front side impact protection work in conjunction with electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist to help keep you and your passengers secure. The blind spot warning system provides extra awareness, and a low tire pressure warning helps maintain optimal vehicle health.

The practical touches throughout the Rogue demonstrate Nissan's commitment to owner satisfaction. The Latitude trim strikes a balance between comfort and value, featuring a well-appointed interior with heated front seating and a power driver's seat with lumbar support. The cabin is designed for occupant comfort, offering power windows, power door mirrors, and dual-zone climate control through the air conditioning system. The 2.4L four-cylinder engine produces the power expected from this compact crossover, with EPA-estimated fuel economy of 22 city and 30 highway. The nine-speed automatic transmission with 4WD capability gives you traction in varied weather and road conditions, while the all-season floor mats protect your interior investment.

This Compass is equipped with modern conveniences including the Uconnect 4 infotainment system with its seven-inch touchscreen, steering wheel audio controls, and AM/FM radio with six speakers. Tilt and telescoping steering, cruise control, and a trip computer make longer drives manageable and enjoyable.

Located at Southern of Norfolk 2747 N Military Hwy Norfolk VA (across from the airport), this 2018 Jeep Compass Latitude offers dependable transportation with a thoughtful mix of features. We invite you to schedule a test drive to experience its capability and comfort firsthand.

This 2018 Chevrolet Equinox LT delivers a dependable midsize SUV experience with refined styling and practical everyday functionality.

- Confidence & Convenience Package with Driver Confidence and Driver Convenience features
- Blackout Package with gloss black emblem kit, black surround grille, and black bowtie emblems
- All-Weather Floor Liners for protection and durability
- Custom Molded Rear Splash Guards
- Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control
- 8-Way Power Driver Seat with heating
- Rear Power Liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Remote Vehicle Starter System

- Rear Park Assist with Audible Warning and Rear Cross Traffic Alert

This Equinox comes equipped with a 1.5L DOHC engine paired with a 6-Speed Automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, providing balanced performance with an EPA rating of 24 city and 30 highway miles per gallon. The combination of capability and efficiency makes this SUV suitable for both daily commuting and weekend adventures.

The exterior showcases a striking black finish complemented by the Blackout Package customization, which includes gloss black emblems, black surround grille, and mosaic black mirror caps. These enhancements create a cohesive, modern appearance while the spoiler and body-color bumpers contribute to the vehicle's refined stance.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes comfort and connectivity. The dual zone automatic climate control allows both driver and passenger to set preferred temperatures independently. Heated front seats provide warmth during colder months, while the 8-way power driver seat with memory ensures you'll find your ideal driving position. The leather-wrapped steering wheel with integrated audio controls keeps premium touches within reach, and the telescoping and tilt steering column accommodates various driver preferences.

Safety and convenience systems work together to enhance your driving experience. The Rear Park Assist with audible warning guides you when backing into tight spaces, while Rear Cross Traffic Alert provides additional awareness. Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert helps prevent unintended lane departures. Dual front airbags, side airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection, complemented by electronic stability control and traction control.

The versatile cargo area features a rear power liftgate that opens at the push of a button, and the split folding rear seat expands storage capacity for larger items. All-weather floor liners protect the cabin from moisture and dirt, while custom molded rear splash guards shield the vehicle's undercarriage.

This 2018 Equinox LT represents solid midsize SUV value with thoughtful amenities and a proven track record of reliability. Schedule your test drive today to experience its capable performance and comfortable interior firsthand.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics

The 2018 Ford Escape SEL offers a capable and well-equipped platform for your daily driving needs, combining practicality with modern conveniences in a compact crossover design.

- Voice-Activated Touchscreen Navigation System with pinch-to-zoom capability
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with AppLink/Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM Audio with five-year prepaid subscription
- Heated Leather-Trimmed Front Bucket Seats

Technology integration centers on the voice-activated touchscreen navigation system, which features SiriusXM Traffic and Travel Link capabilities to keep you informed on your routes. SYNC 3 provides seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, ensuring your essential apps remain within easy reach. The premium audio system includes six speakers, AM/FM radio, CD player, and SiriusXM satellite radio with a five-year prepaid subscription.

Safety equipment reflects a comprehensive approach to occupant protection, including dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags working alongside electronic stability control and anti-lock brakes. The exterior parking camera and rear parking sensors assist with maneuvers, while speed-sensing steering and independent suspension work together to support confident handling.

This SEL model represents solid value for buyers seeking a dependable crossover with modern amenities and all-wheel drive capability. We welcome the opportunity to help you explore what this Escape offers.

Rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather changes, while delay-off headlights provide extended illumination as you approach your destination.

This Discovery Sport presents a compelling option for those seeking a luxury compact SUV with practical capability, modern safety technology, and everyday comfort. We invite you to schedule a comprehensive test drive and discover how well this vehicle aligns with your transportation needs.

The Cold Weather Group and Comfort/Convenience Group packages demonstrate that this vehicle has been thoughtfully equipped for real-world needs. From the engine block heater for cold starts to the dual-zone climate control for passenger comfort, these features address practical concerns.

The sunroof and premium audio system elevate the driving experience, while modern connectivity options keep you seamlessly integrated with your devices. Safety features including multiple airbags, anti-lock brakes, and electronic stability control provide confidence on every drive.

Inside, you'll find cloth and premium vinyl bucket seats with a split-folding rear seat that adapts to your cargo needs. The telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preference, while the rear-view mirror with auto-dimming capability enhances visibility in varying light conditions.

This Cherokee represents a practical choice for those who value the blend of utility, comfort, and dependable performance that the Latitude Plus trim delivers.

This 2019 Chevrolet Equinox LT offers practical, everyday capability wrapped in a sleek silver exterior that maintains its appeal with every drive. Whether you're navigating city streets or cruising the highway, this mid-size SUV delivers the comfort and connectivity you need at a compelling value.

- Bluetooth connectivity and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration
- Heated driver and front passenger seats for cold-weather comfort
- Backup camera for confident reversing and parking
- Remote start system for convenient engine priming
- Dual-zone automatic climate control for personalized comfort
- Rear power liftgate for hands-free cargo access
- Alloy wheels with all-weather floor liners and integrated cargo liner
- Rear cross traffic alert and lane change alert with side blind zone detection
- Rear park assist with audible warning
- SiriusXM satellite radio with Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system

This Equinox comes equipped with comprehensive safety features including four-wheel independent suspension, electronic stability control, traction control, and advanced airbag systems. The braking system features four-wheel disc brakes with brake assist and ABS. Lane change alert with side blind zone alert, rear cross traffic alert, and rear park assist give you added confidence in any situation.

The interior prioritizes comfort and functionality with front bucket seats, a power-adjustable driver seat with lumbar support, and a spacious cabin designed for both driver and passengers. The climate control system maintains independent temperature zones, while heated outside mirrors and a rear window defroster tackle weather challenges. Premium cloth trim and thoughtful storage solutions make this a welcoming environment for daily drives.

This vehicle has been thoroughly inspected and passed our comprehensive 40-point evaluation. It includes a clean Carfax report and carries a 6-month, 6,000-mile limited powertrain warranty, giving you peace of mind as you take ownership.

The 2019 Equinox LT represents a straightforward choice for buyers seeking a dependable SUV with modern conveniences and practical features. We invite you to visit our showroom, take this vehicle for a test drive, and see how well it fits your lifestyle and driving needs.

This 2019 Ford Escape SEL offers a well-rounded combination of capability, style, and everyday practicality for drivers seeking a reliable compact SUV. With its 1.5L EcoBoost engine paired with 4WD and a 6-speed automatic transmission, this Escape delivers responsive performance whether navigating city streets or handling varied road conditions, while achieving an estimated 22 city and 28 highway miles per gallon.

- SEL Sport Appearance Package with distinctive styling cues
- 19" Aluminum wheels with black painted pockets
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with AppLink/Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Front and rear magnetic-painted skid plates
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control with heated front seats
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Rear backup camera and rear parking sensors
- Roof rack rails for additional storage capability
- Heated power door mirrors with magnetic-painted caps
- 6-speaker AM/FM stereo with SiriusXM and MP3 capability
- Electronic Stability Control with traction control and brake assist
- Four-wheel independent suspension for enhanced handling
- Speed-sensing steering for responsive control
- Multiple airbags including front, side, and overhead protection

The SEL model balances comfort and functionality with features designed for everyday driving. The heated ActiveX-trimmed front bucket seats provide support and climate control during colder months, while the split-folding rear seat maximizes versatility for cargo or passengers. Power windows, locks, and steering are complemented by steering wheel-mounted audio controls for convenient operation without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety remains a priority in this Escape's design. Beyond the comprehensive airbag system, you'll benefit from electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, ABS brakes, and low tire pressure warning. The SYNC 3 system includes 911 Assist for emergency communication, providing an additional layer of security on the road.

The gray exterior is enhanced by the SEL Sport Appearance Package, which includes black front fender vents, black headlamp bezels, magnetic-painted upper grille bars, and satin chrome trim accents. The two-tone interior trim panels and magnetic-painted sideview mirror caps add visual interest, while the black beltline molding and magnetic-painted skid plates reinforce the purposeful design.

This Escape comes equipped with practical amenities including fully automatic headlights, front fog lights, rear window defroster, and variably intermittent wipers. The telescoping tilt steering wheel, remote keyless entry, and illuminated entry system contribute to user-friendly operation, while the trip computer and outside temperature display keep you informed during every drive.

This 2019 Ford Escape SEL delivers practical capability with its 1.5L EcoBoost engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and 4WD drivetrain. The Escape SEL combines comfort and convenience throughout the cabin. Heated front seats keep you warm during colder months, while the power driver seat lets you find your ideal driving position. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading cargo, and the split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for passengers and cargo configuration.

Safety is prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. You'll also benefit from four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, brake assist, electronic stability control, and traction control. The exterior parking camera and rear parking sensors provide additional confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces.

SYNC 3 keeps you connected with AM/FM SiriusXM radio, and seamless integration with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto means your smartphone features are accessible right on the dashboard. Steering wheel audio controls let you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.
